facts.fact: CBOS Circular 7/2026 says mobile-payment financial institutions hold a CBOS licence under the 2020 regulation, and CBOS approves every USSD financial service before launch and supervises it.

CBOS Circular 7/2026 sets binding minimum rules for USSD financial services: fee disclosure, no debit on failed transactions, free SMS confirmations, 24-hour support and complaint resolution within 48 hours.

SDN.note: Government payments are only a permitted USSD service, with no payment to people described.

facts.fact: CBOS Circular 7/2026 permits banks, licensed mobile-payment institutions and payment providers to open e-wallets, transfer money, pay bills and take merchant payments over USSD.

SDN.note: Government payments are named only as a permitted USSD service, with no tax or fee described.
